The '''Tasariq Rangers''' were a contracted [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. Comprised of a clan of [[Iotran/Legends|Iotrans]] led by [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]], the Tasariq Rangers patrolled the planet's outlying regions, as well as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Tasariq City]].<ref name="J15" />
